items.name: Brussels sprouts, roasted
items.preparation: Roasted or pan-browned whole sprouts, about 17-20 pieces, charred and glossy on the outside. Mass is estimated from piece count and size; the FDC entry is the closest available match for a cooked sprout.

fdc.description: Brussels sprouts, NS as to form, cooked

items.name: Cooking oil (residual)
items.preparation: Thin sheen on the sprouts implied by roasting or sautéing. Not separately visible, so this is an inferred item.

rows: Brussels sprouts, cooked, boiled, drained, with salt

scale_cues: White square plate about 24-26 cm across used as the scale reference. Individual sprouts measure roughly 2-3 cm in diameter against it. The plate is roughly 60% covered by food in the center-left area.
assumptions: Overhead view, so the sprout count is taken from the visible pieces only; hidden pieces underneath are not counted.
Sprouts are whole, not halved, based on the rounded shapes.
Cooked sprout weight is about 8-12 g per piece, from typical raw sprout weight of about 15-20 g minus water loss during roasting.
The oil item is inferred from the glossy, browned surface and is not a separately visible food.
